title: SkillZone — Online Learning Platform API
description: Online learning API for managing educational centers, branches, courses, instructors, and student interactions. Features role-based access control, JWT authentication, Google OAuth 2.0, course management with progress tracking, quizzes, and PDF certificate generation. Includes Stripe payment integration.
shortDesc: Online learning platform API with RBAC, JWT, OAuth 2.0, and Stripe payments

title: Eye Phone — Mobile Shop Management System
description: A production-ready REST API for managing mobile phone retail shops. Built as a multi-tenant SaaS system where a super admin provisions and manages multiple shop accounts. Uses Sequelize ORM with MySQL and Redis for caching.
shortDesc: Multi-tenant SaaS for mobile shop management with MySQL and Redis

title: Workflow Automation Platform
description: A full backend project in TypeScript featuring an engine that executes Workflows — execution chains of Triggers and Actions. Includes templating with Mustache, Retry and Queue with BullMQ and Redis, and a Scheduler with node-cron. Demonstrates strong system design and complex business logic.
shortDesc: TypeScript workflow engine with triggers, actions, queues, and scheduling

title: E-commerce API
description: A full-featured e-commerce backend API built with Node.js and Express. Implements JWT authentication, role-based access control, product management with categories, shopping cart, order processing, text search, filtering, pagination, and sorting.
shortDesc: Full e-commerce backend with auth, products, cart, and orders
features: Product CRUD with categories and search
Filtering by category and price range

title: Social App Backend
description: A social media backend API built with TypeScript and Node.js. Handles user profiles, posts, comments, likes, follows, and real-time notifications.
shortDesc: Social media backend with posts, comments, likes, and follows

title: WiFi Captive Portal Backend
description: A professional Node.js backend for a WiFi Captive Portal system with enhanced security features including secure complex codes, rate limiting for login attempts, and one-time device binding.
shortDesc: Secure WiFi captive portal with rate limiting and device binding
features: Rate limiting for brute force protection

title: LinkIt Clone — Educational Assessment Backend
description: A pragmatic clone of an educational assessment and analytics backend. Multi-tenant with district/school isolation, RBAC, assessments, item scoring, submissions, analytics, and interventions workflows.
shortDesc: Multi-tenant educational assessment platform with analytics

title: SaaS Multitenant API
description: A multitenant SaaS backend with DB-per-tenant architecture. Tenancy via subdomain or x-tenant-id header. JWT authentication and Stripe subscription integration.
shortDesc: Multitenant SaaS with DB-per-tenant, subdomain routing, and Stripe

title: Mobile Service Backend Pro
description: A professional backend system for a Mobile Repair Service. Supports user roles (Admin, Technician, Customer), a device repair workflow from pending through in-progress to completed, and inventory tracking.
shortDesc: Mobile repair shop backend with role-based repair workflow

title: ProjectFlow — Project Management API
description: A project management backend API for managing projects, tasks, teams, and deadlines. Supports task assignment, status tracking, and team collaboration features.
shortDesc: Project management API with tasks, teams, and deadlines

title: Fitness Tracker API
description: A RESTful API for logging workouts and getting summary statistics. Users can create workout routines, log exercises, and view their progress over time.
shortDesc: Log workouts and track fitness progress

title: Microservices Project
description: A microservices-based architecture demonstrating service decomposition, API gateway pattern, inter-service communication via message queues, service discovery, and containerized deployment with Docker.
shortDesc: Microservices demo with API gateway, message queues, and Docker

title: Online Polls API
description: A RESTful API for creating polls, casting votes, and viewing results in real-time. Supports multiple choice questions, anonymous voting, and poll expiration.
shortDesc: Create polls, vote, and view real-time results

title: URL Shortener API
description: A URL shortening service that converts long URLs into short, shareable links. Supports custom aliases, click tracking with analytics, and link expiration.
shortDesc: Shorten URLs with custom aliases and click analytics

title: Video Streaming Platform API
description: A backend for a video streaming platform with user authentication, video upload and streaming, like and comment functionality, and user channel management.
shortDesc: Video streaming backend with upload, stream, likes, and comments

title: Event Booking API
description: A RESTful API for event management and ticket booking. Supports creating events with capacity limits, booking tickets with conflict detection, waiting list management, and event analytics.
shortDesc: Event management and ticket booking with capacity control

title: File Upload Service
description: A simple file upload service that accepts multipart form-data uploads and stores files on the server. Supports file type validation and size limits.
shortDesc: File upload API with type validation and size limits

title: Online Quiz API
description: Create quizzes with multiple choice questions and automatically grade answers. Supports quiz creation, question banks, and instant result calculation.
shortDesc: Create quizzes and auto-grade answers

title: Library Management System API
description: Manage books and members in a library. Supports book cataloging, member registration, borrowing and returning books with due date tracking.
shortDesc: Library system with book catalog, members, and borrow/return

title: Weather Proxy API
description: A simple proxy API for OpenWeather that fetches weather data for a given city. Demonstrates API proxying, caching, and environment variable configuration.
shortDesc: OpenWeather proxy API with caching

title: Restaurant Orders API
description: A RESTful API for restaurant menu management and order processing. Supports menu CRUD, placing orders with multiple items, and order status tracking.
shortDesc: Restaurant menu and order management API

title: Finance Tracker API
description: A simple transactions API for tracking personal finances. Supports income and expense entries, categorization, and summary reports.
shortDesc: Personal finance tracker with income/expense tracking

title: Notes API
description: A CRUD API for managing notes with tags, search functionality, and user authentication. Supports rich text content and note categorization.
shortDesc: CRUD notes API with tags and search

title: Job Board API (Mini LinkedIn)
description: A job board backend API inspired by LinkedIn. Supports user registration with recruiter/seeker roles, job posting and listing, and job applications.
shortDesc: Job board API with recruiter/seeker roles and applications

title: Analytics Dashboard (Real-time)
description: A real-time analytics dashboard backend with event ingestion API, real-time metrics streaming via Socket.IO, and threshold-based alerting.
shortDesc: Real-time analytics with Socket.IO and threshold alerts

title: To-Do List API
description: A simple REST API for managing to-do tasks with full CRUD operations. Built with Node.js, Express, and MongoDB with Mongoose.
shortDesc: Simple to-do list API with CRUD operations

title: Real-time Chat (Socket.IO)
description: A real-time chat server built with Socket.IO supporting rooms, messaging, typing indicators, and room user lists. Uses in-memory storage with Redis-ready architecture.
shortDesc: Real-time chat with Socket.IO, rooms, and typing indicators

title: Task Manager (Trello-like) API
description: A Trello-inspired task management API with Boards, Lists, and Tasks as nested documents. Supports CRUD for all levels and a simple members array per board.
shortDesc: Trello-like API with boards, lists, and tasks

title: Auth System API
description: A complete authentication system API with user registration, JWT-based login, and protected profile routes. Demonstrates secure password hashing and token management.
shortDesc: Complete auth system with registration, JWT login, and protected routes

title: Blog API (Advanced)
description: An advanced blog API with JWT authentication, role-based access (user/admin), posts CRUD with slug and tags, likes, comments, search with query parameter, filtering by tag/author/published status, pagination, and sorting. Includes Joi validation and Swagger documentation.
shortDesc: Advanced blog API with roles, search, pagination, Swagger docs
features: Posts CRUD with slug and tags

title: Chatbot API
description: A rule-based chatbot API that processes user messages and returns intelligent responses. Supports multiple conversation flows, context awareness, and easy extensibility.
shortDesc: Rule-based chatbot with conversation flows and context awareness

title: Saraha App — Anonymous Messaging API
description: An anonymous messaging platform inspired by Saraha. Users receive anonymous messages with optional identity hiding. Features user registration, message management, and privacy controls.
shortDesc: Anonymous messaging platform with privacy controls
